purpose: Canonical local historical/durable memory system built from the complete ChatGPT export. GPT_Data remains immutable source evidence; Memory owns canonical storage, retrieval, derived memory and MCP exposure; reasoning agents remain the reasoning authority.
authority_rule: Live Memory workspace/runtime evidence outranks this GPT-Knowledge projection. GPT_Data is immutable source evidence. Current runtime/workspace/session/project evidence outranks historical conversation evidence; historical evidence outranks derived memory; model inference is lowest authority. Memory exposes capabilities and provenance but does not prescribe the agent's reasoning procedure.

nodes.title: Discovery + source contract
nodes.summary: ChatGPT export structure, manifest relationships, conversation tree, attachments, timestamps and immutable-source boundary proven against the real archive.

nodes.title: Canonical import model
nodes.summary: Immutable canonical entities, stable composite message identity, idempotent import and missing-object preservation proven.

nodes.title: Canonical SQLite storage
nodes.summary: Versioned transaction-safe canonical store implemented with deterministic identifiers and repeatable ingest.

nodes.title: Semantic retrieval
nodes.summary: Separate rebuildable semantic index implemented over canonical data.

nodes.title: Hybrid retrieval
nodes.summary: Exact, semantic, temporal and conversation signals combined while preserving provenance.

nodes.title: Durable derived memory
nodes.summary: Derived memory stored separately from canonical evidence with provenance and soft supersession.

nodes.title: MemoryService capability API
nodes.summary: recall, search, timeline, conversation, message, related and sources expose structured evidence/derived results without reasoning orchestration.

nodes.title: Memory MCP server
nodes.summary: Seven Memory capabilities exposed through stdio/in-process MCP transport; canonical historical data returns with provenance.

nodes.title: Global MCP Local integration
nodes.summary: Memory registered under C:\MCP Local, stdio handshake/tools/list/tools/call proven, and external client discovery with historical recall proven.

nodes.title: Agent memory experience
nodes.summary: Evidence guidance, provenance descent, evidence-vs-derived distinction and agent autonomy proven. Corrected authority chain: runtime > workspace > session > project docs > historical evidence > derived memory > inference.

nodes.title: Scale / failure validation
nodes.summary: Real ~3.7 GB corpus validated: repeat/restart/interruption, duplicate prevention, malformed/missing objects, latency, size, vector rebuild, canonical survival and provenance round-trip. 91 tests passed.

nodes.title: End-to-end acceptance
nodes.summary: Cases A-G passed against the real GPT_Data archive: recall, exact descent, stale-history separation, two MCP tool paths, missing-memory no-invention, restart survival, and zero-duplication re-index with canonical identity and provenance preserved.
